result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers give a concrete navigation outline, a detailed component template, and good handling of search and deep links, including aliases and section anchors. B fits a two-person team better: it names the pages to launch first (Home, color and spacing, Components) and defers the rest. Its template also has a dedicated States section, an owner field and aliases in the header. A makes what-changed easier to find with a 'what's new' link on Home and links to the changelog from each component page. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers give a concrete site map and a strong component template with anchored sections and aliases for search. A fits a two-person team better because it names the minimal launch set (home, color and spacing, components) and says the rest can follow, and its template includes an owner. B does better on surfacing what changed, with a 'what's new' link on home and a changelog on each component page, but it never says which pages to defer and leaves ownership off the component page.
